title: Search-Budget Artifacts in Continuous Causal Emergence: replication package
description:
Clean reproducibility package for the paper Search-Budget Artifacts in Continuous Causal Emergence: Fixed-Step Riemannian Optimization Can Manufacture Apparent Scale Dependence. Contains the production estimator and CPU-only reproduction runners, the data-retrieval script for the industry portfolio returns, the four figures, archived numerical outputs, and a Lean 4 formalization of the exact closure decomposition plus a related Rayleigh-Ritz compression inequality.

The industry portfolio returns are not redistributed; they are retrieved from the Kenneth R. French Data Library and verified by SHA-256 against the file used in the paper. Manuscript and journal submission materials are intentionally excluded.
